2609.21827.title: RheoSampling: Resolving the One-Hot Dilemma in Stochastic Dynamic-Tree Speculative Decoding
2609.21827.paper_summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by drafting multiple tokens in parallel, with tree-based methods further improving efficiency through hierarchical structures. Dynamic-tree methods such as EAGLE-3 perform well under greedy decoding via deterministic top-K expansion and global pruning. However, in stochastic decoding (T>0), this mechanism collapses the draft distribution into one-hot probabilities, causing a severe drop in acceptance rate. This creates a dilemma: dynamic-tree methods sacrifice stochastic sampling to preserve context-aware topology, while static-tree methods preserve stochastic sampling with context-agnostic structures. The issue arises because the same probability distribution is used for two conflicting tasks: constructing the tree and verifying tokens. This coupling makes direct injection of randomness challenging due to the resulting stochastic process. We resolve this by decoupling these roles: RheoSampling assigns a token sampled from the draft distribution a proxy probability for tree expansion and pruning alongside its true sampling probability for verification. Specifically, we inject a sampled token among the deterministic top-K slots and treat it with different probabilities during construction and verification, making RheoSampling the first dynamic-tree method with both context-aware top-K construction and stochastic sampling while maintaining losslessness. We establish the lossless guarantee through an equivalence-class analysis that compresses the stochastic tree space into tractable classes. An OT-based verification strategy and a sparse draft mechanism ensure that theoretical gains translate into practical efficiency. Experiments across LLMs and benchmarks demonstrate improvements in acceptance rate and speedup over state-of-the-art dynamic tree methods. This framework may provide a template for analyzing stochastic tree structures.
2609.21827.paper_summary_zh: 推測解碼透過平行草擬多個標記來加速大型語言模型（LLM）的推理，基於樹的方法進一步通過層次結構提高效率。像 EAGLE-3 這樣的動態樹方法在貪婪解碼下表現良好，通過確定性 top-K 擴展和全局修剪。然而，在隨機解碼（T>0）中，這一機制將草擬分佈壓縮為一熱概率，導致接受率急劇下降。這造成了一個困境：動態樹方法犧牲隨機取樣以保留上下文感知的拓撲，而靜態樹方法則保留隨機取樣但使用上下文無關的結構。問題出在於，同一概率分佈被用於兩個相互衝突的任務：構建樹和驗證標記。這種耦合使得直接注入隨機性變得具有挑戰性，因為這會導致隨機過程。我們通過解耦這些角色來解決這個問題：RheoSampling 為從草擬分佈中取樣的標記分配一個用於樹擴展和修剪的代理概率，並與其用於驗證的真實取樣概率一起使用。具體而言，我們在確定性的 top-K 槽中注入一個取樣標記，並在構建和驗證過程中以不同的概率對待它，使 RheoSampling 成為第一個具有上下文感知的 top-K 構建和隨機取樣的動態樹方法，同時保持無損性。我們通過等價類分析建立無損保證，將隨機樹空間壓縮為可處理的類別。一種基於 OT 的驗證策略和稀疏草擬機制確保理論增益轉化為實際效率。在 LLM 和基準測試中的實驗顯示，在接受率和速度上相較於最先進的動態樹方法有了改進。這一框架可能為分析隨機樹結構提供了一個模板。
